```lean
intro hX
let cX := Cardinal.ofType X
have h_cX_lt_κ : cX < κ := hX
let α := Ordinal.lift (Ordinal.mk ⟨0, 0⟩) (fun x => x)
have h_inj : Injective (fun x => x) := injective_id
have h_card_α_eq_κ : Cardinal.mk α = κ :=
  by
    let μ := Cardinal.mk α
    have h1 : μ ≤ κ := le_of_exists_injective (fun x => x) α κ
    have h2 : κ ≤ μ := 
      by
        rw [Cardinal.mk_le_iff_exists_injective]
        exact exists_injective (fun x => x) κ μ
    exact le_antisymm h1 h2
exact CategoryTheory.IsCardinalPresentable.mk h_inj h_card_α_eq_κ
```
